standard_prerequisites.name: Comparability graph and the partition number p(G)
standard_prerequisites.statement: A comparability graph has an edge between two vertices exactly when the corresponding elements of a partially ordered set are comparable, and p(G) is the minimum number of edge-disjoint comparability subgraphs of G whose union is the whole edge set; retained at source lines 117-120 and 128.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted theorem asserts p(G) <= 2 for a class of graphs, so the class used in the partition and the parameter bounded must be available.

standard_prerequisites.name: Line graphs and the class LBIP
standard_prerequisites.statement: The line graph of a graph G has the edges of G as its vertices, two of them adjacent when the corresponding edges of G share a vertex, and LBIP denotes the class of line graphs of bipartite graphs, which the article records at source lines 255-257 as a well-known class of perfect graphs.
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the graphs of the counted theorem as line graphs of bipartite graphs and supplies the bipartition [A,B] of the underlying bipartite graph that the proof uses to label the edges.

core_obligations: Write G as the line graph of a bipartite graph H = [A,B] (source line 265).

Label every edge of G by the letter a when the corresponding edge of H has its endpoints one in A and one in B and meets edges of H only at its A-endpoint, and by b in the opposite case, so that each edge of G receives exactly one label (source line 266).
Observe that the edges labelled a form a union of complete graphs with no edges between them, and that the same holds for the edges labelled b (source line 267).
Conclude that the two labelled classes are edge-disjoint comparability graphs covering the whole edge set of G, so that p(G) <= 2 (source line 268).

proof_roadmap.step: Present G as the line graph of a bipartite graph H = [A,B] and label its edges by a or b according to which side of H the corresponding adjacency sits on.
Identify each label class as a union of complete graphs with no edges between them.
Conclude that the two label classes partition the edge set of G into two comparability graphs.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2408.13523v2 的 Theorem bipline（源 259-260 行，证明 265-268 行）：对 LBIP 图（二部图的线图）证明 p(G)<=2。证明的关键不是例行核验：必须先把 G 写成一个二部图 H=[A,B] 的线图，再按其对应边在 H 中的相交位置把 G 的每条边打上 a 或 b 两个标签，从而把 E(G) 分成两类（265-266 行）；随后要看出每一个标签类内部是「两两相交的边构成的完全图」之并、且不同完全图之间没有边，因而该标签类本身是可比图（267 行），两个标签类边不交且覆盖全部边即得结论（268 行）。难点在于把线图的顶点相交关系翻译成两个各自的传递定向，标签的定义必须保证同一标签类内不出现跨完全图的边；原文位置在证明的 266-267 行。
